title: Linux commit ce286d32 — [NET]: Implement network device movement between namespaces

claims_extracted.claim: The device-movement component added NETIF_F_NETNS_LOCAL and dev_change_net_namespace, treating a move as unregistering from one namespace and registering in another; namespace teardown returns movable devices to init_net.
claims_extracted.notes: This is lifecycle/interface evidence, not an operational-deployment date.

notes: Exact Torvalds-tree anchor for the 15/16 device-movement component.
